title: Japan national CPI (October 2026) — the last national print before the December BoJ board convenes
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release', page's own 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'), re-fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 13,839 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its single 17-row HTML table by this session, independently of the fetches that seeded the sibling Japanese entries. Against the header 'Japan: Survey month | Date of release || Ku-area of Tokyo (preliminary): Survey month | Date of release || Remarks', the row parses exactly as ['October', 'November 20', 'November', 'November 27', ''] — i.e. the October-2026 national CPI releases 2026-11-20, with an empty Remarks cell, so this release carries no yearly or fiscal-yearly average. Filed estimate on three counts, identical to every sibling Japanese entry: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: for US statistical agencies and no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the schedule page has not been refreshed since 2026-01-23. Release time is not read off this page and is not asserted here.
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-11-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and tracked for two measured reasons rather than for completeness — three other dated Japanese releases found in the same sweep (Tokyo September flash 2026-10-02, national September 2026-10-23, Tokyo October flash 2026-10-30) were deliberately NOT filed, because each would spend its own never-assessed session to learn nothing. FIRST: this print publishes the naive predictor that the whole Tokyo-flash-as-lead-indicator claim is raced against. Across 103 months (2018-01 to 2026-07), predicting the national core year-on-year rate, simply reusing LAST month's national print has mean absolute error 0.231pp against the Tokyo same-month flash's 0.201pp — so on 2026-11-27 a reader already holds this number, published seven days earlier, and the flash's entire incremental value is measured against it. Restricted to November months only (n=8) the flash does better, 0.183pp and 88% within +/-0.3pp against this predictor's 0.233pp and 50%, which is the quantitative content of FT-japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-11-27-2. SECOND, and the reason the date matters on its own: the Bank of Japan's December Monetary Policy Meeting runs 'Dec. 17 (Thurs.), 18 (Fri.)' per boj.or.jp's own schedule table, and the national NOVEMBER print does not arrive until 2026-12-18, the morning of the decision and day two of the meeting. This 2026-11-20 release and the Tokyo November flash a week later are therefore the last Japanese CPI observations the board holds when it convenes on 2026-12-17. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is keyed to Japanese CPI, and this entry's value is calibration and attribution rather than a trade.
